mapper.sql: SELECT ses.ses_id AS interviewId, IFNULL(u.nick_name, u.user_name) AS candidate, pos.pos_title AS jobName, cmp.cmp_name AS companyName, CONCAT('第', ses.ses_cascade_round, '轮') AS roundName, ses.ses_mode AS mode, ses.ses_status AS status, ses.ses_start_at AS startTime, CASE WHEN ses.ses_rec_duration_sec IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE CONCAT(FLOOR(ses.ses_rec_duration_sec / 60), '分钟') END AS duration, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(scr.scr_score), 1) FROM t_int_score scr WHERE scr.scr_session_id = ses.ses_id) AS score, 0 AS authFail, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS terminateReason FROM t_int_session ses LEFT JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = ses.ses_candidate_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = tal.tal_user_id LEFT JOIN t_pos pos ON pos.pos_id = ses.ses_position_id LEFT JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY ses.ses_start_at DESC, ses.ses_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_int_session SET ses_status = 2, ses_end_at = NOW(), ses_updated_at = NOW() WHERE ses_id = #{sesId} AND ses_status = 1
